Fill, shadow and rim: 0 flat px off outside the sheet's caption row, 0 px over 12 levels outside the glyph zone (36 flat px counted in the glyph zone of the hover cell, state layer pixels under text); the fill spans the same columns as the reference (168 px at my row scan, equal in both) in rest and hover, so the round 37 width fix holds, and a re-render at 48316ea1f is byte for byte the committed sheet.
